node.title: Re: Not a HASH reference
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So do I understand correctly that @allkeys = keys %$alldrug; is the line that is throwing the error? What does print pp($alldrug); show, and if that shows undef, what does print pp($tree); show?

Also, note that there are much better modules to parse XML than [mod://XML::Simple]! I would recommend either [mod://XML::LibXML] or [mod://XML::Twig].
